s1647: Which of these road signs prohibits the movement of vehicles carrying dangerous goods which, under the law, must be marked with the appropriate identification sign?
s1648: According to paragraph 3.32 of Chapter 3 (Prohibitory signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 3.32 "No vehicles carrying dangerous goods" prohibits the movement of vehicles carrying dangerous goods which, under the legislation of Georgia, must be marked with the appropriate identification sign.
s1649: Which of these road signs prohibits the movement of vehicles carrying explosive and highly flammable cargo which, under current legislation, must be marked with the appropriate identification sign?
s1650: According to paragraph 3.33 of Chapter 3 (Prohibitory signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 3.33 "No vehicles carrying explosive and highly flammable cargo" prohibits the movement of vehicles carrying explosive and highly flammable cargo of classes 1.22–2.4, 3.1, 3.2 and 5.2 as defined by State Standard 19433-88, which, under the legislation of Georgia, must be marked with the "Dangerous goods" identification sign.
s1655: A vehicle is considered oversized (large) if its load sticks out beyond the rearmost point of the vehicle by:
s1656: According to subparagraph "c" of paragraph 8 of Article 47 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, a vehicle is considered oversized (large) if its dimensions exceed at least one of the following: c) length: 20 metres for a road train and 12 metres in all other cases, or if the load sticks out more than 2 metres beyond the rearmost point of the vehicle.
s1658: Which of these combinations of road signs does not apply to vehicles displaying the "Person with disabilities" identification sign?
s1659: According to paragraph 8.18 of Chapter 8 (Additional information signs (plates)) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, plate 8.18 "Except persons with disabilities" shows that the sign does not apply to vehicles displaying the "Person with disabilities" identification sign.
s1661: Which identification sign is fixed to the rear of a motor vehicle fitted with studded tyres?
s1662: According to subparagraph "b" of paragraph 1 of Article 19 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, the driver, or in the cases provided for in subparagraph "d" of paragraph 1 of Article 18 of this Law, the enterprise, must fix the following identification signs to the vehicles specified in this paragraph: b) "Studs": a white equilateral triangle pointing upwards with a red border, containing the black Georgian letter "k" (the side of the triangle is at least 200 mm, the border width is 1/10 of the side). It is fixed to the rear of a vehicle fitted with studded tyres.
s1663: Which identification sign is fixed to the front and rear of a vehicle carrying dangerous goods?
s1664: According to subparagraph "c" of paragraph 1 of Article 19 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, the driver, or in the cases provided for in subparagraph "d" of paragraph 1 of Article 18 of this Law, the enterprise, must fix the following identification signs to the vehicles specified in this paragraph: c) "Dangerous goods": a rectangular orange plate measuring 400 × 300 mm with a black border 15 mm wide. It is fixed to the front and rear of a vehicle carrying such goods, and in the case of a tanker also on its sides (the lower part of the plate must show the United Nations number of the goods and the upper part the hazard identification number; they must be separated by a black horizontal line 15 mm thick crossing the plate at half its height).
s1665: Which identification sign is fixed to the front and rear of a motor vehicle driven by a hearing-impaired driver?
s1666: According to subparagraph "g" of paragraph 1 of Article 19 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, the driver, or in the cases provided for in subparagraph "d" of paragraph 1 of Article 18 of this Law, the enterprise, must fix the following identification signs to the vehicles specified in this paragraph: g) "Hearing-impaired driver": a yellow circle 160 mm in diameter with three black circles 40 mm in diameter drawn inside it, placed at the corners of an imaginary equilateral triangle pointing downwards. It is fixed to the front and rear of a motor vehicle driven by a hearing-impaired driver as defined by a joint order of the Minister of Labour, Health and Social Affairs of Georgia and the Minister of Internal Affairs of Georgia.
s1667: Which identification sign is fixed to the front and rear of a motor vehicle used for driving instruction?
s1668: According to subparagraph "h" of paragraph 1 of Article 19 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, the driver, or in the cases provided for in subparagraph "d" of paragraph 1 of Article 18 of this Law, the enterprise, must fix the following identification signs to the vehicles specified in this paragraph: h) "Training vehicle": a white isosceles triangle pointing upwards with a red border, containing the black Georgian letter "s" (the side of the triangle is at least 200 mm, the border width is 1/10 of the side). It is fixed to the front and rear of a training vehicle. A two-sided sign may also be placed on the roof of a passenger car.
s1669: Which identification sign is fixed to a vehicle whose speed, given its load and technical characteristics, is lower than the speed set by law?
s1670: According to subparagraph "i" of paragraph 1 of Article 19 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, the driver, or in the cases provided for in subparagraph "d" of paragraph 1 of Article 18 of this Law, the enterprise, must fix the following identification signs to the vehicles specified in this paragraph: i) "Speed limit": a reduced colour image of road sign 3.24 showing the permitted speed (the sign diameter is at least 160 mm, the border width is 1/10 of the diameter). It is fixed on the left at the rear of the cargo body of an oversized (large) vehicle or of a vehicle carrying dangerous goods that is driven by a driver with less than 2 years of experience as a driver, and also when the maximum speed of the vehicle according to its technical characteristics is lower than the speed set by paragraph 7 of Article 33 of this Law.
s1671: Which identification sign may, at the driver's discretion, be fixed to the front and rear of a motor vehicle driven by persons with disabilities, or to a vehicle carrying such persons?
s1672: According to subparagraph "a" of paragraph 2 of Article 19 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, the following identification signs may be fixed to a vehicle at the driver's discretion: a) "Person with disabilities": a yellow square with 150 mm sides showing the symbol of road sign 8.17 in black. It may be fixed to the front and rear of a motor vehicle driven by a person with the status of a significant or severe disability, or to a vehicle carrying such persons.
s1673: Which identification sign may, at the driver's discretion, be fixed to a vehicle driven by a doctor?
s1674: According to subparagraph "b" of paragraph 2 of Article 19 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, the following identification signs may be fixed to a vehicle at the driver's discretion: b) "Doctor": a blue square with 140 mm sides containing a white circle 125 mm in diameter with a red cross on it (height 90 mm, stroke width 25 mm). It may be fixed to a vehicle driven by a doctor.
s1675: In this situation, is the driver of the white car prohibited from driving in the direction of the arrow?
s1676: According to subparagraph "a" of the Note to paragraph 4.1.1 of Chapter 4 (Mandatory signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 4.1.1 "Ahead only" allows traffic only in the directions shown by the arrows. According to paragraph 8.18 of Chapter 8 (Additional information signs (plates)) of the same Annex, plate 8.18 "Except persons with disabilities" shows that the sign does not apply to vehicles displaying the "Person with disabilities" identification sign.
s1677: In this situation, is the driver of the yellow car prohibited from driving in the direction of the arrow?
s1681: Which vehicle is parked in breach of the parking rules?
s1682: According to paragraph 5.29 of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 5.29 "Regulated parking zone" marks an area within which parking is regulated. According to paragraphs 8.6.1–8.6.9 of the same Annex, additional information sign (plate) 8.6.8 sets how a vehicle must be parked in a parking area. Plate 8.6.1 shows that all vehicles in the parking area must park on the carriageway along the sidewalk, while plates 8.6.2–8.6.9 show how passenger cars and motorcycles must be parked in a parking area next to the sidewalk.
s1683: Which of these road signs marks a motorway, where the rules governing traffic on motorways apply?
s1684: According to paragraph 5.1 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 5.1 "Motorway" marks a motorway where the rules governing traffic on motorways apply. The sign is placed at the start of the motorway or near it, with plate 8.1.1.

Sign 5.2 is placed at the end of the motorway and at exits from the motorway, and in advance, with plate 8.1.1, 400 and 1000 metres before the end of the motorway.
s1690: Which of these road signs marks a road intended only for cars and motorcycles?
s1691: According to paragraph 5.3 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 5.3 "Road for motor vehicles" marks a road intended only for cars and motorcycles.

s1693: The end of a lane intended for cars

s1700: The end of a road with a lane for route vehicles
s1701: The end of a restricted parking zone

s1704: Mark the start of a lane
s1705: Mark a lane reserved for buses
s1707: According to paragraphs 5.7.1 and 5.7.2 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road signs 5.7.1 and 5.7.2 "Entering a one-way road" mark the entry onto a one-way road or carriageway. The signs are placed before every side entrance. The sign need not be placed where exits from adjacent territories meet the road, if those territories can be entered only from the road marked with sign 5.5.

s1709: The end of a residential zone
s1710: The end of a no-overtaking zone
s1711: According to paragraph 5.12 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 5.12 "End of road with a lane for route vehicles" marks the end of a road marked with sign 5.11.
s1712: Which of these road signs marks the entry onto a road with a lane for route vehicles?
s1713: According to paragraphs 5.13.1 and 5.13.2 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road signs 5.13.1 and 5.13.2 "Entering a road with a lane for route vehicles" mark the entry onto a road marked with sign 5.11. The signs are placed before every side entrance. The sign need not be placed where exits from adjacent territories meet the road, if that territory can be entered only from the road marked with sign 5.11.
s1716: The road signs shown, placed over a lane, apply:
s1714: Only to the lane over which they are placed
s1715: To the whole width of the carriageway
s1717: According to paragraphs 5.11 and 5.14 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic: road sign 5.11 "Road with a lane for route vehicles" marks a road on which route vehicles travel in a specially reserved lane against the general flow of traffic; the sign applies to the lane over which it is placed. Road sign 5.14 "Lane for route vehicles" marks a road on which route vehicles travel in a specially reserved lane in the same direction as the general flow of traffic; the sign applies to the lane over which it is placed.
s1718: Both the number of lanes and the traffic rules set for each lane
s1719: Only the traffic rules set for each lane
s1721: According to paragraph 5.15.8 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 5.15.8 "Number of lanes" shows the number of lanes in the given direction and the traffic rules set for each lane. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the road section, and in built-up areas 50–150 metres before it.
s1725: According to paragraph 5.20 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 5.20 "Speed bump" marks a speed bump on the carriageway. The sign is placed at the speed bump or at marking 1.25, on the side facing approaching vehicles.
s1726: The end of a built-up area
s1729: According to paragraph 5.22 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 5.22 "End of residential zone" marks the end of a residential zone marked with sign 5.21. The sign is placed at every exit from the residential zone.
s1730: Which of these road signs marks the end of a settlement where the traffic rules for built-up areas do not apply?
s1731: According to paragraphs 5.25 and 5.26 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic: road sign 5.25 "Start of settlement" marks the start of a settlement where the traffic rules for built-up areas do not apply; road sign 5.26 "End of settlement" marks the end of a settlement marked with sign 5.25.
s1732: Which of these road signs mark an area within which parking is regulated?
s1733: According to paragraphs 5.27 and 5.29 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road signs 5.27 "Restricted parking zone" and 5.29 "Regulated parking zone" mark an area within which parking is regulated in the corresponding way.
s1734: Which of these road signs marks a place for making a U-turn?
s1735: According to paragraph 7.3.1 of Chapter 7 (Information signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic and the Note to that paragraph, road sign 7.3.1 "U-turn place" marks a place for making a U-turn. Signs 7.3.1 and 7.3.2 are placed before the U-turn place or above it, or in advance with plate 8.1.1. These signs do not allow a left turn.
s1736: Which of these road signs gives information about a first aid station?
s1737: According to paragraph 6.1 of Chapter 6 (Service signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 6.1 "First aid station" informs road users about the corresponding facility or service.
s1738: Which of these road signs gives information about a filling station?
s1739: According to paragraph 6.2 of Chapter 6 (Service signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 6.2 "Filling station" informs road users about the corresponding facility or service.
s1740: Which of these road signs gives information about vehicle servicing?
s1741: According to paragraph 6.3 of Chapter 6 (Service signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 6.3 "Vehicle servicing" informs road users about the corresponding facility or service.
s1742: Which of these road signs gives information about a car wash?
s1743: According to paragraph 6.4 of Chapter 6 (Service signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 6.4 "Car wash" informs road users about the corresponding facility or service.
s1744: Which of these road signs gives information about a telephone?
s1745: According to paragraph 6.5 of Chapter 6 (Service signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 6.5 "Telephone" informs road users about the corresponding facility or service.
s1746: Which of these road signs gives information about a restaurant or café?
s1747: According to paragraph 6.6 of Chapter 6 (Service signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 6.6 "Restaurant or café" informs road users about the corresponding facility or service.
s1748: Which of these road signs gives information about drinking water?
s1749: According to paragraph 6.7 of Chapter 6 (Service signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 6.7 "Drinking water" informs road users about the corresponding facility or service.
s1750: Which of these road signs gives information about a hotel or motel?
s1751: According to paragraph 6.8 of Chapter 6 (Service signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 6.8 "Hotel or motel" informs road users about the corresponding facility or service.
s1752: Which of these road signs gives information about a campsite?
s1753: According to paragraph 6.9 of Chapter 6 (Service signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 6.9 "Campsite" informs road users about the corresponding facility or service.

s1755: A section of road where the carriageway narrows on both sides
s1756: An intersection of roads of equal importance
s1757: According to paragraph 5.36 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 5.36 "Merging point" marks the point where an access road from another road (an acceleration lane) merges with the motorway.

s1758: The presence of a patrol police post
s1759: The presence of a zone of radio contact with the emergency services
s1761: According to paragraph 6.11 of Chapter 6 (Service signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 6.11 "Patrol police post" informs road users about the corresponding facility or service.
s1762: Which of these road signs gives information about an international road transport checkpoint?
s1763: According to paragraph 6.13 of Chapter 6 (Service signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 6.13 "International road transport checkpoint" informs road users about the corresponding facility or service.
s1764: The presence of an international road transport checkpoint
s1765: The presence of a reception zone for a radio station broadcasting traffic information

s1769: The presence of a reception zone for a radio station broadcasting traffic information
s1770: According to paragraph 6.15 of Chapter 6 (Service signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 6.15 "Emergency services radio contact zone" informs road users about the corresponding facility or service.
s1771: Which of these road signs gives information about a zone of radio contact with the emergency services?
s1772: Which of these road signs shows that there is an emergency stopping lane on a steep descent?
s1773: According to paragraph 7.5 of Chapter 7 (Information signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 7.5 "Emergency stopping lane" shows that there is an emergency stopping lane on a steep descent. The sign is placed before the entrance to the emergency stopping lane.
s1774: Which of these road signs shows the length of a U-turn zone?
s1775: According to paragraph 7.3.2 of Chapter 7 (Information signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 7.3.2 "U-turn zone" shows the length of the U-turn zone.
s1776: In the zone of which of these road signs is a U-turn allowed?
s1777: According to subparagraph "a" of the Note to paragraphs 4.1.1-4.1.6 of Chapter 4 (Mandatory signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, signs 4.1.1-4.1.6 allow traffic only in the directions shown by the arrows, and signs that allow a left turn also allow a U-turn. According to the Note to paragraphs 7.3.1 and 7.3.2 of Chapter 7 (Information signs) of the same Annex, road signs 7.3.1 "U-turn place" and 7.3.2 "U-turn zone" are placed before the U-turn place or above it, or in advance with plate 8.1.1. These signs do not allow a left turn.
s1778: Which of these road signs gives information about a swimming pool or beach?
s1779: According to paragraph 6.16 of Chapter 6 (Service signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 6.16 "Swimming pool or beach" informs road users about the corresponding facility or service.

s1789: The wheel formula of motor graders is A x B x C, where B is the number of driving axles.

s1803: The driver of the passenger car may continue driving:
s1804: According to paragraph 4 of Article 29 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, to regulate the movement of vehicles in the lanes of a carriageway where the direction of traffic is reversed, a reversible-lane traffic light with a red X-shaped signal and a green arrow pointing downwards is used. This signal and this arrow respectively prohibit or allow traffic in the lane above which they are located. The main coloured signals of a reversible-lane traffic light may be supplemented by a yellow or white signal with an arrow pointing diagonally downwards to the right or to the left; when it comes on, it warns that the coloured signal is about to change and that drivers must move into the lane indicated by the arrow. A reversible-lane traffic light that is switched off, located above a lane marked on both sides with road marking 1.9, prohibits entering that lane.

s1834: Gear pumps are used in positive-displacement hydraulic drives.
s1839: In what kind of ground is a multi-roller crawler undercarriage used?
s1840: A multi-roller crawler undercarriage is used in soft ground.

s1846: The diagonal brace is one of the parts of a bulldozer's working equipment.
s1850: At what speed does a wheeled tractor develop its normal tractive force?
s1851: A wheeled tractor develops its normal tractive force at 6-9 km/h.
s1854: What is the maximum speed at which a wheeled tractor may travel on the road?
